Auténtico 1 · Capítulo 1A

Record Yourself

Listen, speak, compare, and choose your best recording.

Instructions
  • Listen to the model sentence.
  • You may replay the model sentence at any time for reference.
  • Then record yourself saying the same sentence.
  • Record yourself 3 times.
  • Choose your best recording before moving on.
  • Focus on clear Spanish pronunciation, not speed.
  • On completion, you may download a compilation of your chosen best attempts to email to your teacher.
  • Your finished audio compilation with transcripts also plays right on this page, so if downloading is not permitted on your managed device, you can still watch it here or share your screen with your teacher or class to review it (e.g. Google Meet).
